cues.en: Shalom, how is life family circumstances and everything? Ah, that's nice. Anyway, in today's video I'm going to show what it takes to create a Doom-style 3D engine for scratch. First, some important questions. Why in the classic PC game of Doom, when you make a map, it requires a slow and expensive process of building a BST before the map can be rendered in 3D? While in Duke Nukem 3D's build, you can change the map and render it in real time.
cues.zh: 大家好，近来生活、家庭一切都还顺利吗？挺好的。不管怎样，在今天的视频里，我将向大家展示如何从零开始构建一个 Doom 风格的 3D 引擎。首先来看几个关键问题：为什么在经典的 PC 游戏 Doom 中，制作地图时需要经过一个缓慢且高开销的 BSP 构建过程，然后才能进行 3D 渲染？而在 Duke Nukem 3D 的 Build 引擎中，你却可以实时修改地图并进行渲染。

cues.en: Why in Duke Nukem 3D it is possible to create multistair buildings and even non-euclidean geometry, while in Doom it is not? First, let's brush up on some basic vector and prospective calculations. Let's declare a wall, which is a line segment with two ends, an X and Y coordinate for both ends. The player also has an X and Y coordinate, and an angle for where he is looking towards.
cues.zh: 为什么在 Duke Nukem 3D 中可以做出多层建筑甚至是违背欧几里得几何的结构，但在 Doom 中却不行？首先，我们先来温习一些基本的向量和透视计算。我们先来定义一面墙，它是一条带有两个端点的线段，两个端点分别有各自的 X 和 Y 坐标。玩家同样有一个 X 和 Y 坐标，以及一个表示朝向的视角角度。

cues.en: Let's create some sample basic code for visualizing the world we just created. Sorry about using such an obsolete language, but I have found out that graphical programming basic still makes for an excellent prototyping tool. And let's face it, even if you have never programmed in basic, you can probably follow the meaning of this code very well for the most part.
cues.zh: 我们来写一些简单的 BASIC 代码，把刚刚创建的世界可视化出来。很抱歉用了这么一门过时的语言，但我发现图形化的 BASIC 仍然是非常出色的原型开发工具。说实话，即便你从没写过 BASIC 代码，大部分代码的意思你也基本能看懂。

cues.en: The yellow line represents the wall, and the white dot is that layer, with a small line that indicates where the player is looking towards. In order to make a first-person engine, the global view must be transformed into a first-person view. This concept should be familiar to anyone who watched my previous video about OpenGL programming. In OpenGL, the camera never moves.
cues.zh: 黄色的线代表墙壁，白点代表玩家，附带的一小段线段表示玩家正在朝哪里看。为了做成第一人称引擎，我们必须把全局视角转换成第一人称视角。看过我之前 OpenGL 编程视频的观众，对这个概念应该不会陌生。在 OpenGL 中，摄像机其实是永远不动的。

cues.en: Instead, the whole world is moved, rotated and drawn around the perfectly mobile camera. Here, we do exactly the same. Transform the world. We can see the second window how the player is always in the center, and the world moves around him. This creates an illusion of a first person view. But this isn't 3D yet. The third important step we need to learn is perspective.
cues.zh: 相反，整个世界是围绕着完全静止的摄像机在进行移动、旋转和绘制。在这里，我们做的完全是一回事：变换整个世界。在第二个窗口中我们可以看到，玩家始终位于中心，而世界则围绕着他移动。这就制造出了第一人称视角的假象。但这还算不上真正的 3D。我们需要掌握的第三个关键步骤是透视。

cues.en: The perspective projects 3D coordinates into two-dimensional screen coordinates, you take the X and Y coordinates and divide them with the Z coordinate. That's as simple as it is. As you can see here, the wall seems to get smaller when the player moves away from it, and larger when the player gets closer. There is a slight problem though. When the wall is even partially behind the player, something odd happens because of negative signs that are produced by the perspective calculations.
cues.zh: 透视会将 3D 坐标投影到二维屏幕坐标上，你只需拿 X 和 Y 坐标除以 Z 坐标即可。就是这么简单。正如你在这里看到的，当玩家远离墙壁时，墙壁似乎变小了；而当玩家靠近时，它就变大了。不过这里有个小问题：当墙壁哪怕只有一部分位于玩家身后时，透视计算中产生的负号就会引发一些诡异的现象。

cues.en: Some additional mathematics needs to be added into the program to address this specific problem. Mathematically speaking, it is the hardest part of this all. Frankly, I am not even sure if I am doing it right. To clip the wall, we need to find out where it intersects with a player's field of vision. Finding these intersections involves a formula called vector cross product. The vector cross product is like black magic.
cues.zh: 我们需要在程序中加入一些额外的数学计算来解决这个特定问题。从数学角度来说，这是整个过程中最难的部分。坦白讲，我甚至都不确定自己的做法对不对。为了对墙体进行裁剪，我们需要找出它与玩家视野相交的位置。求出这些交点需要用到一个叫作向量叉积的公式。向量叉积简直就像黑魔法一样神奇。

cues.en: I still don't understand what it does, but somehow it ended up all around in my video after I read a few Wikipedia articles. The wall only needs to be clipped if it is partially behind the player, i.e. one of its z-coordinates is negative. If both are negative, the wall is totally behind the player, and it does not even need to be rendered. Now we can see that even when the player gets close to the wall, it is rendered properly.
cues.zh: 我还是不明白它是做什么的，但在我读了几篇维基百科文章后，它不知怎么地就遍布在我的视频里了。只有墙部分位于玩家身后时，也就是它的一个 z 坐标是负数时，才需要裁剪这面墙。如果两个 z 坐标都是负数，这面墙就完全在玩家身后，甚至不需要渲染。现在可以看到，即使玩家靠近墙壁，它也能被正确渲染。

cues.en: You can change the wireframe wall into a solid wall by rendering vertical lines in a loop. A meaningful scene should also have many walls, not just one. You can notice that ceiling is always everything above the wall, and the floor is always everything below the wall. Here I have colored the ceiling gray and the floor blue. The only way this differs from the previous version is that there's now five walls instead of one.
cues.zh: 你可以通过循环渲染竖线，把线框墙变成实心墙。一个有意义的场景还应该有许多面墙，而不只是一面。你可以注意到，天花板始终是墙上方的一切，地板始终是墙下方的一切。这里我把天花板涂成灰色，把地板涂成蓝色。它和上一版本唯一的区别是，现在有五面墙，而不是一面。

cues.en: This works perfectly as long as your level geometry is completely convex. Convex means that there are no dents in it. It's like a rubber band stretched over all the edge points. Here's what happens if we try to apply the same algorithm to a non-convex map. It seems to work alright, until... well, it doesn't work right. The engine appears to be drawing a far side wall over a near side wall.
cues.zh: 只要你的关卡几何体完全凸，这一方法就能完美工作。凸意味着它没有任何凹陷。就像一根橡皮筋绷在所有边缘点上。下面是我们把同样的算法应用到非凸地图时会发生什么。看起来好像没问题，直到……好吧，它出错了。引擎似乎把远侧的墙画在了近侧的墙上面。

cues.en: Well, that's easy to fix, you might think. Let's just reverse the rendering order. And yes, this did fix the error in this very instance. But see, there's now another error that wasn't there before. Figuring out how to prevent fireside walls from showing through near-side walls is a problem that every 3D engine in the world must solve.
cues.zh: 你可能会想，这很容易修。只要把渲染顺序反过来就行了。没错，在这个具体例子里，错误确实被修好了。但是你看，现在又出现了之前没有的另一个错误。弄清楚如何防止远侧墙透过近侧墙显示出来，是世界上每个 3D 引擎都必须解决的问题。

cues.en: A related problem is when you have a huge map that consists of thousands or millions of walls, how to render only those walls that can possibly contribute to either view, and not spend time futilely rendering all those walls that are completely behind other walls. Unsurprisingly, there are many different ways to solve both problems. For the remainder of the video, let's study how Nuke Nukem 3D solves the latter problem.
cues.zh: 一个相关的问题是：当你有一张由数千或数百万面墙组成的巨型地图时，如何只渲染那些可能对任一视野有贡献的墙，而不是浪费时间徒劳地渲染所有完全位于其他墙后面的墙。不出所料，解决这两个问题有很多不同的方法。在本视频剩余部分，我们来研究 Duke Nukem 3D 如何解决后一个问题。

cues.en: but could in fact solve both at once, and then create our own 3D engine. This is the level editor for Duke Nukem 3D, called Build. Let's create a sample map. So far it is just a simple rectangular room. But suppose we wanted to have the ceiling in one part higher than in another part, we would have to divide the map into two sections, called sectors. The ceiling and floor heights for different sectors can be adjusted separately.
cues.zh: 但实际上可以一次性解决这两个问题，然后创建我们自己的 3D 引擎。这是 Duke Nukem 3D 的关卡编辑器，叫做 Build。让我们创建一个示例地图。到目前为止，它只是一个简单的矩形房间。但假设我们想让某一部分的天花板比另一部分更高，就必须把地图分成两个区域，称为扇区。不同扇区的天花板和地板高度可以分别调整。

cues.en: This geometry is still all convex. There are no indents anywhere in the map geometry. Suppose we create some obstacles, though. Now the map geometry contains obstacles and corners, through which you cannot see something anymore. In other words, it is non-convex. However, each individual sector of the map is still convex. Non-convex geometry is created by joining several convex sectors together.
cues.zh: 这个几何体仍然完全是凸的。地图几何体中没有任何凹陷。不过，假设我们创建一些障碍物。现在地图几何体包含障碍物和拐角，你无法再透过它们看到某些东西。换句话说，它是非凸的。然而，地图的每个单独扇区仍然是凸的。非凸几何体是通过把几个凸扇区连接在一起形成的。

cues.en: If you pay attention to how it all is rendered, you will see that there are now two types of walls or sector edges. Regular walls that span from our floor to our ceiling. And doorways or portals, which have three segments. A wall that spans from our floor to their floor. A window through which the next sector can be seen.
cues.zh: 如果注意观察它的渲染方式，你会发现现在有两种墙体，或者说扇区分割线。一种是从我们的地板延伸到天花板的普通墙体；另一种是门道或传送门，它包含三个部分：一段从我们的地板延伸到对方地板的墙体；一扇能看到下一个扇区的窗户；

cues.en: And finally, a wall that spans from their ceiling to our ceiling. In the editor you can see the difference more clearly. A white edge is one where there's nothing behind, i.e. it's a wall that spans from floor to ceiling. And a red edge is an edge between two sectors. We call these red edges portals. Now what happens if their floor is lower than the floor of our sector?
cues.zh: 最后是一段从对方天花板延伸到我们天花板的墙体。在编辑器里可以更清楚地看到区别。白色边代表背后没有任何东西，也就是一面从地板直通天花板的墙；红色边则是两个扇区之间的交界线，我们把这些红边称为传送门。那么，如果对方的地板比我们扇区的地板更低，会发生什么呢？

cues.en: The lower wall segment just shrinks until it doesn't get rendered at all. Similar thing happens with the ceiling. The upper wall is rendered downwards beginning from our ceiling until we reach their ceiling. If their ceiling is higher, we simply start rendering their sector immediately. For the purpose of this video, I created a simple custom map.
cues.zh: 下方的墙体段就会直接缩小，直到完全不被渲染。天花板也是类似的情况。上方的墙体会从我们的天花板开始向下渲染，直到碰到对方的天花板。如果对方的天花板更高，我们直接开始渲染对方的扇区就行了。为了这个视频，我制作了一张简单的自定义地图。

cues.en: This map contains multiple sectors, windows between different sectors, staircases, rooms vertically on top of each other, and even non-euclidean geometry, perfect for our sample program. Going back to my high-tech illustration board, I drew the map on paper and numbered each vertex in each sector, and having done that, I wrote those numbers and they coordinates into a text file. Now I am going to do something revolutionary as far as my videos are concerned.
cues.zh: 这张地图包含多个扇区、不同扇区之间的窗户、楼梯、垂直叠放的房间，甚至还有非欧几里得几何，非常适合我们的示例程序。回到我那块高科技绘图板上，我先在纸上画出了地图，并给每个扇区的每个顶点编了号，做完这些后，我把这些编号和它们的坐标写进了一个文本文件。现在，就我的视频而言，我要做一件极具颠覆性的事了。

cues.en: I am going to write some C code, not C++. I know, this sounds incredible, but as I was designing the tutorial program for this video, I thought to myself, why not write C for change? After all, there are people in my audience who love C, but are totally lost when I write C++ code. So today is your day. I am writing code that is strictly C with none of those C++ gimmicks.
cues.zh: 我打算写一些 C 代码，而不是 C++。我知道这听起来不可思议，但在为这个视频设计教程程序时，我心想，换换口味写 C 语言怎么样？毕竟我的观众里有些人喜欢 C，但在我写 C++ 代码时却完全看不懂。所以今天就是你们的福利日了。我写的是纯粹的 C 代码，没有任何 C++ 的花哨特性。

cues.en: So the first part of this program deals with loading the map I just showed to you into data structures used by this program. Because the file handling code is somewhat dull to watch, I sped it up by about 200%. Rest assured, I won't do that again in the remainder of this video. Actually, maybe it's just me who is the dull one here. Maybe I should just shut up and let the code speak for itself.
cues.zh: 所以这个程序的第一部分，就是把刚才展示给你们看的地图，加载到该程序使用的数据结构中。因为看文件处理代码有点枯燥，所以我快进了大概 200%。放心，在接下来的视频里我不会再这么做了。其实，也许只是我自己比较无聊罢了。也许我应该直接闭嘴，让代码自己说话。

cues.en: This is the part where I regret a little that I chose to write in C. Oh well. Here is the C version of the vector cross product function. As you can see, it can be used to implement several other useful functions. I have no idea why it works, but it does, which is the important thing. Now we are getting to the actual drawing code, so please pay attention.
cues.zh: 写到这里，我稍微有点后悔选择用 C 语言了。好吧。这是 C 语言版本的向量叉积函数。如你所见，它还可以用来实现其他几个很有用的函数。我完全不知道它为什么能行，但它确实可以，这才是最重要的。现在我们要进入真正的绘制代码了，所以请集中注意力。

cues.en: Remember how I explained before how everything is given to be drawn using vertical lines. This V-line function will be used to cross ceilings, walls and floors, i.e. the whole screen. No other graphics functions will be needed for our prototype 3D engine. The rendering will begin from the sector where the player is in.
cues.zh: 还记得我之前解释过，所有内容都要用竖线来绘制。这个 V-line 函数会用来穿过天花板、墙壁和地板，也就是整个屏幕。我们的原型 3D 引擎不需要其他图形函数。渲染将从玩家所在的扇区开始。

cues.en: All edges of this sector will be processed. The edge is first translated and rotated, so it's relative to the player's gaze. And then the sign software resulting the coordinates are inspected to determine whether the edge is visible from the player's point of view. Once we have a visible edge, we can do a perspective transformation. This transformation is accomplished by these scale division calculations.
cues.zh: 这个扇区的所有边都会被处理。首先对边进行平移和旋转，使其相对于玩家的视线。然后检查所得坐标的符号，判断这条边从玩家视角是否可见。一旦得到可见边，就可以做透视变换。这个变换由这些按比例除法计算完成。

cues.en: From the perspective transformations we get screen coordinates, an X coordinate for the left side of the wall, and an X coordinate for the right side of the wall, and a Y coordinate for the floor and ceiling heights in both sides of the wall. Before that we must do the clipping trick that I explained at 2.52 in this video. Anyway, from those coordinates drawing the wall is just a matter of linear interpolation and calling V-line in a loop.
cues.zh: 通过透视变换，我们得到屏幕坐标：墙左侧的 X 坐标、墙右侧的 X 坐标，以及墙两侧地板和天花板高度的 Y 坐标。在此之前，必须先做我在本视频 2:52 处解释的裁剪技巧。总之，有了这些坐标，画墙就只是线性插值并在循环中调用 V-line 的事。

cues.en: We will draw three vertical lines on each X coordinate. One from the top of the window to the ceiling height, indicating the ceiling. One from the floor height to the bottom of the window, indicating the floor. And one from the ceiling height to the floor height, indicating the wall. For now we draw walls with different colors when they are portals on when they are actual walls. Here's what it looks like.
cues.zh: 我们会在每个 X 坐标上画三条竖线。一条从窗口顶部到天花板高度，表示天花板。一条从地板高度到窗口底部，表示地板。还有一条从天花板高度到地板高度，表示墙。目前，传送门和实体墙会用不同颜色绘制。看起来是这样。

cues.en: Remember the walls are drawn white, portals are drawn red, the floor is blue and the ceiling is grey. On the right you can see the map for reference. Observe how a different view gets drawn when the player crosses sector edge. Now the next step is to add upper and lower walls, above and below the portal. This was explained at 6.20 in this video, so if you are confused as to what's happening, please watch that part again.
cues.zh: 记住，墙画成白色，传送门画成红色，地板是蓝色，天花板是灰色。右边可以看到地图作为参考。观察玩家穿过扇区边界时，视图如何变成不同的绘制结果。下一步是在传送门上方和下方添加上墙和下墙。这部分在本视频 6:20 处解释过，如果你对发生的事情感到困惑，请再看一遍那部分。

cues.en: And this is how it changes the result of this update. The lower wall is drawn magenta, and the upper wall is drawn white, and the window or portal is drawn in red. The only thing remaining is to draw the neck button sector in that window. To do that you need three things. First is some means to draw another sector. You could use recursion to do that. Here I used the circular buffer as a queue of pending sector draw requests.
cues.zh: 这次更新会这样改变结果。下墙画成品红色，上墙画成白色，窗口或传送门画成红色。剩下唯一要做的是在那个窗口里绘制相邻扇区。要做到这一点，需要三样东西。第一是绘制另一个扇区的方法。你可以用递归来做。这里我用环形缓冲区作为待处理扇区绘制请求的队列。

cues.en: Second is the window size. By window I mean the screen area where the sector can be drawn. For the player sector this area is the entire screen. For any neighbor sector it is a smaller view. There is a left edge Sx1 and the right edge Sx2. Additionally there is a top and bottom Y coordinate for each column on the screen.
cues.zh: 第二是窗口大小。我说的窗口，是指可以绘制该扇区的屏幕区域。对于玩家所在扇区，这个区域是整个屏幕。对于任何相邻扇区，它是一个更小的视图。它有左边界 Sx1 和右边界 Sx2。此外，屏幕上每一列都还有顶部和底部的 Y 坐标。

cues.en: This vertical window gets smaller and smaller the deeper you go in the view. And thirdly you need... Wait, I guess you only need two things after all. This clip shows in slow motion how the spring gets rendered by this algorithm. Aside from the familiar colors, it shows the current window in green. You can see quite clearly how it considers each edge green,
cues.zh: 视角越深入，这个垂直窗口就会变得越来越小。第三点你需要……等等，我想其实只需要两样东西。这段视频慢速演示了该算法是如何渲染弹簧的。除了熟悉的颜色外，它还用绿色显示了当前的窗口。你可以很清楚地看到它是如何将每条边视为绿色的，

cues.en: In turn, drawing either a fully white wall or a white upper wall, red portal and a maggot lower wall, here is another viewpoint. When all edges of the current sector have been rendered, it picks one of the remaining red portals and repeats the process inside that window.
cues.zh: 依次绘制纯白色的墙，或是白色的上墙、红色的传送门和洋红色的下墙，这里是另一个视角。当当前扇区的所有边都渲染完毕后，它会挑选剩下的红色传送门之一，并在该窗口内重复这一过程。

cues.en: This is the rendering at normal speed. Observe how things like tunnels under stairs or windows in walls are supported without problems. On the right you can see a from-top illustration of what the player is currently seeing. The current sector is indicated in red shading. Any part of a floor or a ceiling that is currently within the player's view is indicated in green, violet or gray shading for an effect that looks a bit like a torch being.
cues.zh: 这是正常速度下的渲染效果。注意观察像楼梯下的隧道或墙上的窗户这类元素是如何被顺利支持的。在右侧，你可以看到玩家当前视野的俯视示意图。当前扇区用红色阴影标出。当前处于玩家视野内的任何地板或天花板区域都会用绿色、紫色或灰色阴影表示，看起来有点像火炬光照的效果。

cues.en: Now, I cheated here a little because I demonstrated the program before it was even finished. I didn't even add the main program yet. For the sake of completeness, I will add the remaining parts to the program, so you will not be cheated.

cues.en: This function of move player is responsible for making sure that the game always knows which sector the player currently is in even as he moves around and crosses the edges of the sectors. cues.en: When the player is pushing against the wall, we need a formula that produces a vector that is parallel to the wall, but has a length that depends on the angle between the player's movement and the wall's direction. This formula is called vector projection, and I copied it directly from Wikipedia.
cues.zh: 当玩家顶着墙移动时，我们需要一个公式，生成一个与墙平行的向量，但其长度取决于玩家移动方向与墙方向之间的夹角。这个公式叫向量投影，我直接从维基百科上抄了过来。

cues.en: This produces the sliding-along-the-wall effect that is standard in all third-person games today. This simple hack here adds support for looking up and down, with a restriction that all walls still remain perfectly vertical. Now, suppose we want to add some depth shading to walls. A very simple way to do that is to color the vertical line with a darker color when the wall is farther from the camera, i.e. the Z coordinate is higher. Here is what it looks like in practice.
cues.zh: 这样就产生了现代所有第三人称游戏里标配的贴墙滑动效果。这里这个简单的小技巧加入了上下视角支持，同时限制所有墙仍然保持完全垂直。现在假设我们想给墙加上深度明暗。一个很简单的做法是：当墙离摄像机越远，也就是 Z 坐标越大时，就用更暗的颜色画这条垂直线。实际效果就是这样。
